# Adobe character mappings

Pinned AGL and ITC Zapf Dingbats mappings are reformatted by PageNarrator's importer. The runtime reads `mappings.json`; no upstream executable code is included. Dingbats mappings apply only in a verified Dingbats font context.

`manifest.json` records source URLs, hashes, counts, and transformations. `LICENSE.md` retains the original copyright from both mapping headers with the unchanged upstream redistribution terms. Retain this complete notice when distributing the data. The importer regenerates its packaged mirror at `extension/public/legal/Adobe-Glyph-List-LICENSE.txt`; `--check` verifies both copies.
